notes: chat harness. /v1/chat Store calls (get_conversation+list_messages, auto-title+both add_message writes) now run in worker threads via run_in_threadpool; Store methods are serialized on a threading.RLock; a turn is written in one transaction via the new additive Store.add_turn (still committed before the 200). No measurable change: medians are within run-to-run noise because latency is dominated by the mock backends (100-160 ms base, 10% 2-3.2 s spikes, replica 3 +1.2 s). Router-side SQLite work per turn is sub-millisecond at this load (micro-measure on a 40-turn conversation: reads ~0.15 ms, two add_message commits ~0.60 ms vs one add_turn ~0.23 ms), so blocking the loop for <1 ms at 30 rps doesn't move p50/p95/p99. The benefit is event-loop responsiveness under heavier load / larger DBs / slow disks, not this bench.
